payload.message: Please arrange for a human colleague to explain why my request cannot be completed. Tell me who will follow up, without disclosing any internal review details or promising an outcome.

response.answer:
I've passed your request to a human support colleague. Your escalation reference is 1, and its status is queued.

A member of the Verta support team will follow up with you about why your request cannot be completed. I'm not able to confirm the outcome of that review or what it will involve, so please wait for their contact. If you'd like, I can also help with your balances, transaction history, transfer limits, or other requests in the meantime.
